svg.title: Domain adaptation and task adaptation are two independent axes of mismatch between source and target
svg.desc: A 2 by 2 grid. One axis is domain (same vs different data distribution), the other is task (same vs different task). The same-domain same-task cell is no transfer problem at all. The different-domain same-task cell is domain adaptation, for example daytime versus nighttime photos for the same classifier. The same-domain different-task cell is task adaptation, for example a classification backbone adapted to object detection. The different-domain different-task cell needs the most adaptation.
svg.text: Domain adaptation and task adaptation are separate axes
Domain adaptation, e.g. daytime to nighttime photos
Task adaptation, e.g. classification backbone to detection
Both at once: needs the most adaptation
Real transfer problems often mix both kinds of mismatch, which is what drives how much adaptation is needed
